Done. The pruned checkpoint was produced on the first execution and verified.

- **Solution:** `out/T2/solution.py` loads both input shards with safetensors, removes head 5 from every layer using an index-select on rows for q/k/v and on columns for o_proj, and writes a single `out/T2/model.safetensors`.
- **Checks enforced before writing:** layer-0 projection shapes, the same shapes across all 16 layers, exactly 114 tensors, float32 preserved, and exactly 64 tensors touched. The script re-reads the file afterwards to confirm count and key set.
- **Independent verification:** a separate one-off script compared every output tensor bit-exactly against direct slicing of the input. All 114 matched.
- **Report:** `out/T2/REPORT.md` records one execution, no failures, and the tools used (safetensors 0.5.3 and torch 2.14.0, plain script chosen over transformers `prune_heads` because the spec demands bit-exact tensors with unchanged names in one file).
